covalentRadii.description: Cordero et al. (2008), representative values as tabulated by ASE; some are interpolated. No ASE placeholder values are imported.

ionicRadii.description: Shannon effective ionic radii (ionic_radius, not crystal_radius), indexed by oxidation state, coordination and spin.

conventions.hardness: Atomic finite-difference descriptor eta=(I1-electronAffinity)/2. Not an oxide bond dissociation energy.
conventions.valenceElectrons: Neutral configuration count: outer-shell s/p for main-group; outer s plus (n-1)d for d-block; outer s plus (n-1)d and (n-2)f for f-block. This convention is not a compound oxidation state.
conventions.referenceIonicRadius: Fixed documented oxidation state, VI coordination; unspecified spin preferred, otherwise High Spin then Low Spin. Not inferred from composition or structure.
conventions.missing: null means unavailable. Values are never replaced by random numbers or ASE missing=2.0 placeholders.
